biesc_: The new rifleman is Jonas "Mole" Biesc, once a ferryman from Esterhaus. The corporal asked if a ferryman was any use in a trench. Jonas "Mole" Biesc said he would find out.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Jonas "Mole" Biesc. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. A letter from home reached Jonas "Mole" Biesc before dusk. Jonas "Mole" Biesc read it twice and slept a little easier.
Arno "Crow" Hakkinen cut Jonas "Mole" Biesc's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.
Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Jonas "Mole" Biesc read a theatre review while peeling supper.
A dog crosses no man's land at the Sunken Road every night, fed by Jonas "Mole" Biesc on one side and Isidor "Tin" Brayden on the other. The Concord call it Patrol. The Hegemony call it Spy.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-S9. Jonas "Mole" Biesc has learned to walk bent double.

Jonas "Mole" Biesc washed his face and someone asked if headquarters was visiting. Apparently being clean needs an explanation. Jonas "Mole" Biesc got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 375. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Jonas "Mole" Biesc watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Jonas "Mole" Biesc reads Yann Kwintenlulay's letters from home out loud, because Yann never learned to read. Mole leaves out the sad parts. Yann knows.
Jonas "Mole" Biesc was absent when the patrol returned from Verdel Ridge. The corporal checked the list against the faces, then checked it again.
butter_baron468: Jakub "Ash" Baron reached T-F9 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine.

Two shots, one miss. The second found Oskar Mateescu, grazed. Jakub "Ash" Baron cut a small notch in the rifle stock and then wished he had not. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Jakub "Ash" Baron watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Jakub "Ash" Baron watched the enemy lines change the guard at T-F9 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Nils "Ghost" Jlantz was grazed. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Jakub "Ash" Baron wrote to a landlady who kept his room exactly as it was that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Jakub "Ash" Baron mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.
Jakub "Ash" Baron borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing.
chen_paulus11: Konrad "Mole" Paulus arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Konrad "Mole" Paulus helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

A sniper's bullet hit Konrad "Mole" Paulus at R-R2. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Bram Briton of the Concord (@martin.briton). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Konrad "Mole" Paulus fell at R-R2 and never moved again. Shot by Bram Briton of the Concord (@martin.briton).

Cyril "Brick" Paulus had heard about Konrad "Mole" Paulus's courage. At R-R2, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Cyril "Brick" Paulus folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Cyril "Brick" Paulus smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Otto Bowles came out for a cup and was gravely wounded. Cyril "Brick" Paulus was hit in the foot through his boot at R-R2. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. Shot by Otto Bowles of the Concord (@sam_bowles_). Cyril "Brick" Paulus looked over the parapet at R-R2 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Otto Bowles of the Concord (@sam_bowles_).
The House of Paulus sent another. Silas Paulus, brother of Cyril "Brick" Paulus, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Fog so thick that Silas Paulus could not see the end of his own rifle. Somewhere out there, someone was whistling.
egilhermansson: Bastian Egilhermanss arrived on Day 8 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Bastian Egilhermanss was hit in the thigh crossing the Hanging Bridge. He crawled the last yards back to the trench on his elbows.

Bastian Egilhermanss never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line. Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Bastian Egilhermanss wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-S4 and grazed Bastian Egilhermanss's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Gideon "Crow" Colm of the Hegemony (@colm91019). Bastian Egilhermanss got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 507. The men who came later will ask about it. After the loss of Grey Mill, Bastian Egilhermanss helped stack spare sandbags at S-S4. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Bastian Egilhermanss was hit in the hip at S-S4. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Edmund Szymanski of the Hegemony (@franek.szymanski.376).
The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Bastian Egilhermanss. He died on the stretcher before morning.
Konrad "Mole" Egilhermanss came to the front because his cousin Bastian Egilhermanss never came home. He carries a dented harmonica.
eze.glas: The sergeant gave Viktor "Button" Glas a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Viktor "Button" Glas aimed just below it. Pavel Scp was badly wounded. Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Viktor "Button" Glas wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Viktor "Button" Glas's ear at R-R11 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Marek Elox of the Hegemony (@gm_elox). The clerk counted the names twice. Viktor "Button" Glas is number 841 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. After the loss of Grey Mill, Viktor "Button" Glas helped stack spare sandbags at R-R11. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
The wound Viktor "Button" Glas shrugged off has gone the wrong colour. He is not shrugging any more.
There was no room for Viktor "Button" Glas. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.
A letter came with Arno Glas: "I am Viktor "Button" Glas's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
nshill429: The old hands of Q-F8 have been here since Day 1. Ulrich Nshill has been here since Day 10. In a trench, that difference already feels like years. Orders assigned Ulrich Nshill to work as a machine gunner. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

Ulrich Nshill spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Nshill. Ulrich Nshill read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Ulrich Nshill walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

The gun at Q-F8 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Albin Life, grazed. A bullet hit Ulrich Nshill in the neck at Q-F8. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Roland Eugeneous of the Concord (@eugeneous911). Ulrich Nshill looked over the parapet at Q-F8 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Roland Eugeneous of the Concord (@eugeneous911).
A letter came with Casimir Nshill: "I am Ulrich Nshill's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

Dawn watch. Casimir Nshill put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Quentin "Saint" Jankiedestro, grazed. Mail came up the line with a letter for Casimir Nshill. Casimir Nshill read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
sababrouwer: After 13 days of war, V-F9 had a place for everything. On Day 13, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Otto Sababrouwer.
stoppingkloud: Emil Stoppingklou arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying his brother's pocket watch and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Emil Stoppingklou wrote to his mother, who writes every Sunday that night and said only: 'We will take it back.' Emil Stoppingklou's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Face blackened with soot, Emil Stoppingklou spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Silas Kebapien was gravely wounded. A letter from home found Emil Stoppingklou before the night shift. Emil Stoppingklou folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In Q-F22, Emil Stoppingklou listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A loose thread in Emil Stoppingklou's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain. A letter from home found Emil Stoppingklou before the night shift. Emil Stoppingklou folded it small and kept it close.
Emil Stoppingklou tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.
themimicchest: Karel Themimicches left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Lindenbruck and came up the line with a pressed cornflower. The men noticed at once that he writes everything down in a tiny notebook.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Karel Themimicches wrote to a teacher who said he would amount to nothing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Karel Themimicches took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-R10, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Nils Toro of the Hegemony (@fidel_del_toro). Karel Themimicches was hit at S-R10 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Nils Toro of the Hegemony (@fidel_del_toro).

Another member of the House of Themimicches reached the line: Jonas Themimicches. He asked where Karel Themimicches had slept, then chose a different corner. Jonas Themimicches got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 819. The men who came later will ask about it. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Jonas Themimicches wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Jonas Themimicches was carrying water up to S-R10 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Jonas Themimicches did not. Shot by Norbert Fransinlak of the Hegemony (@fransinlak).
Jonas Themimicches returned to S-R10 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
